literal: A submissive person those who become if they see, than them exceedingly behaving, will swell with pride the base person.
translation: If base people see those who submit to them, they will behave with even greater excess and swell with pride over them.
modern: தமக்கு அடங்கி நடப்பவர்களைக் கண்டால், கீழ் மக்கள் அவர்களை விடவும் அதிகமாகத் தலைக்கனம் கொண்டு செருக்குடன் நடப்பார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet describes the arrogant nature of base or low-minded individuals when they encounter submissive people. When a base person (கீழ்) sees someone who is compliant or yields to them (அகப்பட்டி ஆவாரை), they do not show mercy or kindness. Instead, they behave with even greater dominance and arrogance (மிகப்பட்டு), swelling with pride (செம்மாக்கும்) to lord over them. Their power trip is triggered by the helplessness or submission of others, revealing their lack of true nobility.
